dogecoin.text: Definitely wish I had more #dogecoin than I do. Should have bought more when it was under a cent but I guess who knew it would ever actually break through these ceilings??

I know Amazon doesn’t accept #Doge #dogecoin yet, but could some members of #Dogecoinarmy #DogeFamily help to #clearthelists of amazing teachers who need supplies?? You can check the hashtag #clearthelist and find so many lists to choose from. Thank you!!
